pictures.scene: Willem de Poorter, Saul and David in the Cave of En-Gedi — the hunted man crouched in the dark of the cave while the king passes by the mouth of it, to the tune of Do Not Destroy a Miktam of David when he fled from Saul into the cave, have mercy on me O God have mercy
pictures.name: pd_de_poorter_saul_and_david_in_the_cave

pictures.scene: Abbott Handerson Thayer, Angel — the winged girl standing with both white wings spread wide open behind her, for in You my soul takes refuge, in the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter
pictures.name: pd_thayer_angel

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Christ in the Storm on the Lake of Galilee — the boat driven up the face of the wave with the men hauling on the torn sail, until the danger has passed, I cry out to God Most High
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_christ_in_the_storm_on_the_lake_of_galilee

pictures.scene: Ferdinand Bol, The Angel Appearing to Elijah — the angel bending down over the worn-out prophet to wake him and feed him, to God who fulfills His purpose for me, He reaches down from heaven and saves me
pictures.name: pd_bol_the_angel_appearing_to_elijah

pictures.scene: Nicolas Poussin, Christ and the Woman Taken in Adultery — Christ pointing at the ground before the accusers while the woman kneels untouched, He rebukes those who trample me, Selah
pictures.name: pd_poussin_christ_and_the_woman_taken_in_adultery

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Annunciation — the angel sent down and kneeling under the arches with the light coming in behind him, God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_the_annunciation

pictures.scene: Eugène Delacroix, Lion Devouring a Goat — the lion lying out in the open with its kill held down under its paws, my soul is among the lions, I lie down with ravenous beasts
pictures.name: pd_delacroix_lion_devouring_a_goat

pictures.scene: Diego Velázquez, The Surrender of Breda — the wall of upright lances standing over the handing-over of the key, with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_the_surrender_of_breda

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Among the Sierra Nevada Mountains — the light breaking through the cloud over the peaks and coming down on the whole valley, be exalted O God above the heavens, may Your glory cover all the earth
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_among_the_sierra_nevada

pictures.scene: Winslow Homer, The Herring Net — the two fishermen hauling the loaded net up over the side of the dory, they spread a net for my feet, my soul was despondent
pictures.name: pd_homer_the_herring_net

pictures.scene: Jan Matejko, The Battle of Grunwald — the Grand Master who led the invasion run through by two spears in the middle of his own army, they dug a pit before me, but they themselves have fallen into it
pictures.name: pd_matejko_the_battle_of_grunwald

pictures.scene: Jean-François Millet, The Angelus — the woman standing still in the field with her hands folded and her head bowed at the sound of the bell, Selah, my heart is steadfast O God my heart is steadfast
pictures.name: pd_millet_the_angelus

pictures.scene: Gerard van Honthorst, King David Playing the Harp — the king leaning into the strings with his mouth open in song, I will sing and make music, awake my glory
pictures.name: pd_honthorst_king_david_playing_the_harp

pictures.scene: Claude Lorrain, A Seaport at Sunrise — the sun coming up out of the water between the quays with the masts standing black against it, awake O harp and lyre, I will awaken the dawn
pictures.name: pd_claude_lorrain_a_seaport_at_sunrise

pictures.scene: El Greco, The Pentecost — the tongues of fire coming down on the gathered company so that each one speaks, I will praise You O Lord among the nations, I will sing Your praises among the peoples
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_the_pentecost

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, Rainy Season in the Tropics — the double rainbow standing right across the gorge from one side of the sky to the other, for Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds
pictures.name: pd_church_rainy_season_in_the_tropics

pictures.scene: Ivan Aivazovsky, Chaos, the Creation of the World — the light breaking out above the cloud and laid down in a path across the open sea, be exalted O God above the heavens, may Your glory cover all the earth
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_chaos_the_creation_of_the_world

lines.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into the cave.
Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy,
for in You my soul takes refuge.
In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter
until the danger has passed.
I cry out to God Most High,
to God who fulfills His purpose for me.
He reaches down from heaven and saves me;
He rebukes those who trample me.
Selah
God sends forth
His loving devotion and His truth.
My soul is among the lions;
I lie down with ravenous beasts—
with men whose teeth are spears and arrows,
whose tongues are sharp swords.
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens;
may Your glory cover all the earth.
They spread a net for my feet;
my soul was despondent.
They dug a pit before me,
but they themselves have fallen into it!
Selah
My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast.
I will sing and make music.
Awake, my glory!
Awake, O harp and lyre!
I will awaken the dawn.
I will praise You, O Lord, among the nations;
I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens,
and Your faithfulness to the clouds.
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens;
may Your glory cover all the earth.
